extracted.name: Shrimp Butter
extracted.description: This creamy, fluffy shrimp butter dip is made with cream cheese, softened butter, mayonnaise, garlic and lemon. Great for parties!
instruction_lines: Place butter and cream cheese into a medium bowl; beat with an electric mixer. Add shrimp, onion, lemon juice, garlic salt, and mayonnaise; beat until fluffy. Cover and chill for several hours. Bring to room temperature before serving.
